reason: Provider configuration accepts a secret from the UI, while the existing API used wildcard CORS and published Docker port 8080 on all host interfaces. Keep this unauthenticated first slice host-local.
required_invalidations: Add AC07 to implement and verify host-local binding and CORS restrictions.
AC04 must review local-only boundary and must not certify LAN exposure.
decision: Accepted as the least-exposure default for the first local UI slice. LAN use remains unsupported until an authenticated API boundary is implemented.
